title: Weighted least action principle for Maxwell equations
summary: The Fermat principle of least time determines the path of a single ray of light given its initial and final positions and the medium electromagnetic properties. However, a single ray is not a measurable physical object. We derive here an upgraded variational principle for the geometric optics limit of Maxwell equations in an arbitrary medium, based on measuring the intensity of the wave on two planes.
